title: Blanche - Should You Fight Her? (The Fountain Quest)
description: Blanche at The Fountain in Expedition 33 is a choice, not just a boss. Sparing every friendly Nevron earns 100 Colour of Lumina - fighting her means you killed one.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Blanche is a friendly White Nevron found at The Fountain - and whether you fight her at all depends entirely on choices you made across two acts.

This is the payoff of the friendly Nevron questline, not simply a boss to tick off. Read the Rewards section before you decide anything.

sections.title: Where to Find Blanche
sections.content:
Location: The Fountain - inside the middle of the mountain, west of Spring Meadows.

Reaching it requires Esquie's flight ability, so it is an Act 3 location.

On entry you get the Entrance Expedition Flag. Follow the path and interact with Blanche. There is also a Journal - Expedition 84 down the left path - worth grabbing on your way back.

sections.title: Fight or Reward
sections.content:
Blanche has no documented elemental profile, because for most players she is not a fight at all.

Your historyWhat happens
You spared every friendly White NevronShe gives you 100x Colour of Lumina and the Aiding the Enemy achievement. No fight.
You killed any friendly NevronShe fights you instead - and drops far less.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
OutcomeReward
Sparred (no friendly Nevrons killed)100x Colour of Lumina + Aiding the Enemy achievement
Fought and defeatedColour of Lumina x10 + Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x2

The comparison is stark: 100 for sparing versus 10 for fighting - roughly ten times as much, and it is not close.

sections.title: Do Not Attack Friendly Nevrons
sections.content:
This is the single most important thing on this page. One kill anywhere in the friendly Nevron questline locks you out of the 100 Colour of Lumina reward.

  • Do not attack the friendly White Nevrons you meet in Acts 1 and 2
  • Even if you want their drops, do that after speaking to Blanche - not before
  • Already killed one? The reward is gone for that playthrough and Blanche will fight you

Who is involved in the questline

  • Jar and Demineur
  • Benisseur in the Red Woods - requires escalating Chroma donations (5,000, then 10,000, then 25,000, then 50,000). He rewards Pictos along the way
  • Hexga and other friendly White Nevrons

Whenever one offers a choice, spare. That is the condition.
